blessings.lore: A steadying of the wrist, asked at shrines since before the shrines had a roof.
blessings.name: Steady Hands
blessings.description: +3 Hit for all units in every act.

blessings.lore: Pilgrims leave a coin at the shrine. Sometimes the shrine gives one back.
blessings.name: Coin of Fate
blessings.description: +500 gold at run start.

blessings.lore: The old blessing for departing levies: come back heavier than you left.
blessings.name: Blessed Vigor
blessings.description: At run start, lords gain +2 max HP.

blessings.lore: Prayed for by couriers and deserters alike. The goddess does not distinguish.
blessings.name: Swift Instinct
blessings.description: Lords gain +1 SPD at run start.

blessings.lore: The shrine keeps its own stores. No one restocks them; they are stocked.
blessings.name: Field Medic
blessings.description: All units start with a Vulnerary.

blessings.lore: Sworn at the shrine with a hand on cold iron. The iron remembers the terms.
blessings.name: Iron Oath
blessings.description: +2 DEF to lords.

blessings.lore: The old faith walked its borders yearly. The habit of seeing far survives it.
blessings.name: Scout Blessing
blessings.description: Deploy +1 unit.

blessings.lore: A vow of the seer order's lay students: learn quickly, for the term is short.
blessings.name: Scholar's Vow
blessings.description: All growths +5%.

blessings.lore: The old war-blessing, shouted rather than whispered. The goddess hears both.
blessings.name: Rally Cry
blessings.description: +2 STR to all units in Act 1.

blessings.lore: Some shrines prefer scarred hands. Offerings from smooth ones go unanswered.
blessings.name: War Veteran
blessings.description: +15% XP gain from combat.

blessings.lore: A smith-saint's discount, honored at forges that keep the old mark by the door.
blessings.name: Frugal Smith
blessings.description: Forge costs reduced by 30%, +1 forge per shop.

blessings.lore: Old kings armed pilgrims for the worst roads. Something still honors the custom.
blessings.name: Arsenal Pact
blessings.description: Start with a silver weapon.

blessings.lore: The pilgrim roads pay their walkers. No one has ever met the paymaster.
blessings.name: Pilgrim Coin
blessings.description: Shops stock +1 item at 15% discount.

blessings.lore: A curse-blessing. The old faith was not entirely gentle.
blessings.name: Merchant Bane
blessings.description: +15% battle gold.

blessings.lore: Sworn with the roads themselves. The old faith held that roads keep count.
blessings.name: Nomad's Pact
blessings.description: Recruited units join +1 level higher.

blessings.lore: The land remembers who kept its shrines and softens underfoot for them.
blessings.name: Terrain Mastery
blessings.description: +5 avoid and +1 DEF on Forest/Fort tiles.

blessings.lore: A tithe barn's blessing, returned with interest. The barns are long burned.
blessings.name: Quartermaster Cache
blessings.description: Lords gain +1 Elixir at run start.

blessings.lore: Shelved in the temple crypts for a reason. Borrowed from them for a better one.
blessings.name: Forbidden Tome
blessings.description: All growths +15%.

blessings.lore: The forge-rite the smith-saints refused. It works. That was never the objection.
blessings.name: Blood Forge
blessings.description: All lord weapons gain +2 forge levels.

blessings.lore: The war colleges tithed their best lessons to the shrines. The shrines kept them.
blessings.name: War Tutelage
blessings.description: Each lord learns one random skill at run start.

blessings.lore: Shrine cellars were the old kingdom's arsenals of last resort. Some still are.
blessings.name: Armory Stash
blessings.description: Gain 2 random whetstones at run start.

blessings.lore: The seer order copies everything twice. One copy goes where the empire cannot read.
blessings.name: Scroll Archive
blessings.description: Gain 2 random weapon-art scrolls at run start.

blessings.lore: A teaching-blessing: one lesson, learned all the way down.
blessings.name: Focused Curriculum
blessings.description: Lords gain +12% SPD and SKL growths.

3.label: -1 DEF to all units in Act 1
-8 Hit for all units in Act 1

4.label: -2 DEF to all units in Act 1
